findings.observation: The packet labels management reports, indexed proposal passages and unavailable exact-source claims separately. It does not promote the indexed handover account to operational validation.

Sixteen African client missions, sixteen newly assumed entities, thirty-two entities and different April/July milestones remain unreconciled populations and periods. No single denominator is justified by these extracts.

After initial direct-access failures, the official registry opened through its search reference and its ViewPDF link yielded the two-page final80/273 text. Adoption header and terminal record agree; operative paragraphs6–7 independently confirm the exact fiscal maintenance and mixed-share figures. No raw-PDF checksum or operational evidence is claimed.

The exact A/C.5/80/20 note, calendar2027 SPM proposal table, full paragraph70 and complete incorporated ACABQ advice were not independently reauthenticated here. Their retained/indexed qualifications remain necessary.
